register.labelZh: FIX 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: fix on 可以表示某人考慮過幾個可能性後,最終選定日期、地點、顏色或計劃。；你可以用 fix up 談論安排會議、參觀或假期,也可以用 fix somebody up with something 表示替某人安排房間、門票、電腦或其他所需物品。；FIX 片語可以描述某人以強烈眼神盯着另一個人,或把目光和注意力集中在某事物上。；fix yourself up 可用來表示某人整理頭髮或衣服,準備出席晚飯、拍照、派對或會面。
register.summaryEn: Fix on helps you explain that somebody has considered several possibilities and finally selected one, such as a date, place, colour or plan. You can use fix up to discuss arranging meetings, visits and holidays. You can also fix somebody up with a room, ticket, computer or other useful item. The FIX family helps you describe somebody staring strongly at another person or concentrating their eyes and attention on something. Fix yourself up is useful when somebody tidies their hair or clothes and makes themselves look ready for a meal, photograph, party or meeting.
